newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai mulls purchase of assets.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai mulls purchase of assets.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks to buy assets from its major shareholder International Enterprises Co Ltd, and was considering raising capital through a share placement.

"The company is currently negotiating certain acquisitions of assets from its major shareholder International Enterprises Co Ltd, but with no binding agreements so far," the company said in a statement.
First Shanghai also said it is "exploring certain fund-raising proposals", including placement of the company's shares. It gave no further details.
International Enterprises held a controlling 35.76 percent stake of the company as in June 1996.
First Shanghai shares were unchanged at HK$0.85 per share in early trade on volume of 6.07 million shares.
